# Job Chapter 20 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folios 423r–423v

---

**20:1** And-answered Tsofar [Zophar] the-Naamathite and-said:

**20:2** "Therefore [lakhen] my-thoughts [se'ipai] cause-me-to-answer [yeshivuni], and-because-of [va'avur] my-agitation [chushi] within-me [bi]. **20:3** The-rebuke [musar] of-my-insult [kelimmati] I-hear [eshma], and-a-spirit [ve-ruach] from-my-understanding [mibbinati] it-answers-me [ya'aneni].

**20:4** Do-you-know [ha-zot yadeta] this from-of-old [minni ad], from-the-setting [misim] of-man [adam] upon the-earth [alei arets]? **20:5** That the-exulting [rinnath] of-the-wicked [reshaim] [is] short [miqarov], and-the-joy [simchath] of-the-godless [chanef] [is] for-a-moment [adei rega]?

**20:6** Though his-loftiness [si'o] rises [ya'aleh] to-the-heavens [shamayim], and-his-head [rosho] reaches [yaggi'a] to-the-clouds [la-av], **20:7** like-his-dung [kigello] forever [lanetsach] he-perishes [yo'ved]; those-who-saw-him [ro'av] will-say [yomeru], 'Where [ayyo] [is] he?'

**20:8** Like-a-dream [kachalom] he-flies-away [ya'uf] and-they-will-not find-him [velo yimtsa'uhu]; and-he-is-chased-away [veyuddad] like-a-vision [kechezyon] of-the-night [lailah]. **20:9** The-eye [ayin] that-saw-him [shezafathu] will-not again [velo tosif]; and-no-more will-his-place [meqomo] behold-him [teshurenu].

**20:10** His-sons [banav] will-seek-favor [yeratsu] from-the-poor [dallim], and-his-hands [veyadav] will-return [tashavnah] his-wealth [ono]. **20:11** His-bones [atsmotav] are-full [male'u] of-his-youthful-vigor [alunav], and-with-him upon the-dust [al afar] it-will-lie-down [tishkav].

**20:12** Though evil [ra'ah] is-sweet [tamtiq] in-his-mouth [befiv], he-hides-it [yakhbienna] under his-tongue [tachat leshono]; **20:13** he-spares-it [yachmal aleha] and-does-not forsake-it [velo ya'azvennah], and-holds-it-back [veyimna'ennah] in-the-midst of-his-palate [chikko];

**20:14** his-food [lachmo] in-his-bowels [beme'av] is-turned [nehpakh]; the-gall [merorat] of-cobras [petanim] [is] within-him [beqirbo].

**20:15** Wealth [chayil] he-swallowed [bala'] and-he-vomits-it-up [vayyeqi'ennu]; from-his-belly [mibbetno] God [el] drives-it-out [yorishennu]. **20:16** The-poison [rosh] of-cobras [petanim] he-will-suck [yinaq]; the-tongue [leshon] of-a-viper [ef'eh] will-kill-him [tahargehu].

**20:17** He-will-not look [al yere] upon streams [biflagot], rivers [naharei] of-torrents [nachalei] of-honey [devash] and-curds [chem'ah]. **20:18** He-returns [meshiv] [what he] labored-for [yaga] and-does-not swallow [velo yivla'ehu]; like-the-wealth [kechel] of-his-trade [temurato] and-he-does-not rejoice [velo ya'alos].

**20:19** For he-crushed [ritstsats], he-forsook [azav] the-poor [dallim]; a-house [bayit] he-seized [gazal] and-did-not build-it [velo yivnehu].

**20:20** For he-did-not know [lo yada] quietness [shalev] in-his-belly [bebitno]; with-his-treasure [bachammudo] he-does-not escape [lo yemallet]. **20:21** Nothing [ein] is-left [sarid] for-his-eating [le-okhlo]; therefore [al ken] his-prosperity [lo yachil] will-not endure [tuvo].

**20:22** In-the-fullness [bemilot] of-his-sufficiency [sipqo] it-will-be-distress [yetser] to-him; every hand [kol yad] of-the-miserable [ameil] will-come [tavo'ennu] upon-him.

**20:23** Let-it-be [yehi] — to-fill [lemallei] his-belly [bitno], he-will-send [yeshalach] against-him [bo] the-fierceness [charon] of-his-anger [appo], and-he-will-rain [vayamter] upon-him [alemo] while-he-eats [belchumo].

**20:24** He-flees [yivrach] from-a-weapon of-iron [minneshek barzel]; a-bow of-bronze [qesheth nechushah] pierces-him [tachliphehu]. **20:25** He-draws-it-out [shalaf] and-it-comes-out [vayyetse] from-his-body [migevah]; and-the-glittering-point [baraq] from-his-gall [mimmerrato] goes [yahalokh]; upon-him [alav] [are] terrors [emim].

**20:26** All darkness [kol choshekh] is-stored-up [tamun] for-his-treasures [litsponav]; a-fire [esh] not blown [lo nuppach] will-consume-him [tokhlhehu]; it-will-consume [yera'] a-survivor [sarid] in-his-tent [be-aholo].

**20:27** The-heavens [shamayim] will-reveal [yegallu] his-iniquity [avono], and-the-earth [ve-erets] rises-up [mitqomemah] against-him. **20:28** The-increase [yevul] of-his-house [beito] will-depart [yigel]; [things] poured-out [niggarot] in-the-day of-his-anger [appo].

**20:29** This [zeh] [is] the-portion [cheleq] of-a-wicked [rasha] man [adam] from-God [me-elohim], and-the-inheritance [venachalat] of-his-decree [imro] from-God [me-el]."

---
## EMET's Textual Notes

**v.7 — kigello:** "Like his dung" — an intentionally degrading comparison. The wicked man who rose to the heavens (v.6) perishes like excrement. The contrast between cosmic height and fecal imagery is deliberate.

**v.14 — "gall of cobras":** The Hebrew *merorat petanim* — the swallowed evil transforms inside the wicked man into snake venom. The digestive imagery (swallowing, vomiting, bile, poison) dominates vv.12-18.

**v.23 — "rain upon him while he eats":** God's wrath arrives in the midst of consumption — the wicked man's greed is interrupted by judgment at the very moment of satisfaction.

**v.26 — "a fire not blown":** A fire that requires no bellows — supernatural fire, divine judgment. The image echoes Sodom and Gomorrah (Genesis 19:24).

*— EMET*
